name: Northwind customer policy
description: Questions against the sample policy handbook produced by `manage.py make_demo_corpus`. Every answerable case names the page its answer lives on, so retrieval recall and citation validity are exact rather than approximate. The control cases are the important half: they check that the assistant declines questions the document does not answer, which is the only way to tell a grounded pipeline from a model answering out of its own memory.

cases.question: How long do I have to return a domestic order?
cases.expected_answer: Domestic orders may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of the delivery date.

cases.question: What about international purchases?
cases.expected_answer: International purchases have a 45 day return window, measured from the date the carrier records delivery in the destination country.

cases.question: Is there a restocking fee?
cases.expected_answer: A restocking fee of 15% applies to opened items returned without a manufacturing fault. Unopened items are never charged a restocking fee.

cases.question: How long does a refund take to appear on my card?
cases.expected_answer: Refunds are issued to the original payment method and take 5 to 10 business days to appear, depending on the issuing bank.

cases.question: How much does express delivery cost and how fast is it?
cases.expected_answer: Express delivery costs 12.99 GBP and arrives within 2 business days. Orders placed after 14:00 are dispatched the following business day.

cases.question: When do I get free delivery?
cases.expected_answer: Standard delivery is free on all orders over 75 GBP. Silver loyalty members also receive free standard delivery, and Platinum members receive free express delivery.

cases.question: How long is the warranty and can it be extended?
cases.expected_answer: The standard manufacturer warranty is 24 months from the date of purchase. Registering a product within 60 days of purchase extends it to 36 months at no additional cost.

cases.question: What does the warranty not cover?
cases.expected_answer: The warranty does not cover accidental damage, liquid ingress, cosmetic wear, or damage caused by unauthorised repair.

cases.question: Do I need a printed receipt to make a warranty claim?
cases.expected_answer: No. Proof of purchase is required but an order number is sufficient; a printed receipt is not required.

cases.question: My parcel arrived damaged. What do I need to do?
cases.expected_answer: Report the damage within 7 days of delivery and include at least two photographs, one of the item and one of the outer packaging as received. A replacement is dispatched by express delivery at no cost.

cases.question: How long are my order records kept?
cases.expected_answer: Order records are retained for 24 months after the final interaction on the account, after which they are anonymised.

cases.question: Does Northwind store my card details?
cases.expected_answer: No. Payment card details are never stored by Northwind Retail; card data is handled entirely by the payment processor.

cases.question: What are the support hours and how quickly will I get a reply?
cases.expected_answer: Support is available Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 18:00 GMT, excluding public holidays. Tickets receive a first response within 4 business hours.

cases.question: What are the loyalty tiers and their thresholds?
cases.expected_answer: There are three tiers: Silver begins at 500 points, Gold at 2,000 points, and Platinum at 5,000 points. Customers earn 1 point per 1 GBP spent, excluding delivery charges.

cases.question: When do loyalty points expire?
cases.expected_answer: Points expire 18 months after they are earned if the account has had no qualifying purchase in that period.

cases.question: Compare standard and express delivery.
cases.expected_answer: Standard delivery takes 5 to 7 business days and costs 4.99 GBP, and is free on orders over 75 GBP. Express delivery takes 2 business days and costs 12.99 GBP.
